vectors.name: hdr_normal
vectors.description: TIME 0x00ABCDEF, FLAGS 0.

vectors.name: hdr_time_zero
vectors.description: TIME is the host's microsecond clock, low 32 bits; 0 is valid.

vectors.name: hdr_time_max
vectors.description: The clock wraps every 71.6 minutes; boards handle the wrap.

vectors.name: hdr_flag_hint
vectors.description: A valid header. A board that doesn't know a hint processes the frame as usual. Hosts send FLAGS 0 until a hint is defined.

vectors.name: hdr_flag_rw
vectors.description: A valid header: a response window follows the frame (0.2.4, Diff-Power Ultra-Analog receivers). A board without a return channel takes the clock sync, ignores every slot and keeps its lock; a receiver answers its POLL (frame_rw_poll).

vectors.name: hdr_bad_crc
vectors.description: Same as hdr_normal with the last TIME bit flipped: the CRC-8 no longer matches.

vectors.name: hdr_version1
vectors.description: Format 1 (header first, withdrawn, never released). The CRC is correct, but a VERSION 2 board rejects every frame of another version: no lock, no clock sync, no slot.

vectors.name: hdr_bad_magic
vectors.description: MAGIC 0x5BD2 instead of 0x5AD2.

vectors.name: slot_nop
vectors.description: A valid slot that does nothing (idle frames). LIGHT 0, SEQ 0.

vectors.name: slot_dark
vectors.description: 256 zero bits. Deliberately not a valid slot: every board ignores it.

vectors.name: slot_light_def
vectors.description: Roles CH1-CH5 = red, green, blue, warm white, cold white (2 3 4 7 6), gamma 2.8 (2800), flags 0, min power 0 and max power 65535 on every channel. SEQ 0x11.

vectors.name: slot_set
vectors.description: Flags 0x01 (smoothstep). M = 49151 (0.75), A = 65535 26214 0 0 0, B = 65535 x 5, duration 1000 ms, start +30 ms after this frame's TIME. SEQ 0x22.

vectors.name: slot_effect_pulse
vectors.description: Effect 1, start +30 ms (int32). Parameters: on 500 ms (u24), off 500 ms (u24), interval 1000 ms (u24), min 0, max 65535. SEQ 0x33.

vectors.name: slot_effect_breathe
vectors.description: Effect 6, start +30 ms. Parameters: period 5000 ms (u24), min 6553 (0.1), max 65535. SEQ 0x34.

vectors.name: slot_effect_strobe
vectors.description: Effect 2, start +30 ms, step count 2. The steps follow as STEP slots with the same SEQ 0x35.

vectors.name: slot_step
vectors.description: Index 0, count 2, duration 100 ms, transition 0 ms, M 65535, A = red, B = 65535 x 5. SEQ = the strobe EFFECT's SEQ 0x35.

vectors.name: slot_config
vectors.description: LIGHT 0xF (board). Pairs (id, value): PWM preset 8 (25 kHz), stagger 4 (adaptive + spread), LED current CH1-CH3 3000 mA, CH4-CH5 5000 mA, board limit 8000 mA; the 9th pair unused (0, 0). SEQ 0x44.

vectors.name: slot_identify_on
vectors.description: Value 1: blink the identify pattern (30 s). SEQ 0x55.

vectors.name: slot_identify_cal
vectors.description: Value 2, argument 0: the standard test at 25 / 50 / 75 / 100 %. Boards without the input current sense ignore it. SEQ 0x56.

vectors.name: slot_identify_dark
vectors.description: Value 3, argument 10: fade to dark and hold 10 s (or until value 4, RELEASE). SEQ 0x57.

vectors.name: slot_identify_version
vectors.description: Value 5: blink the firmware version once. Firmware from before 0.2.1 ignores it. SEQ 0x58.

vectors.name: slot_scene
vectors.description: Mode 1, cross-fade 10 x 100 ms, M 32768, A = 0 0 0 65535 32768 (warm-ish white), B = 65535 x 5. SEQ 0x66.

vectors.name: slot_light_opt
vectors.description: Flags 0x01. CW LED 153.8 mireds (6500 K) = 1538, WW LED 370.4 mireds (2700 K) = 3704, warm end 555.6 mireds (1800 K) = 5556, red assist 19661 (30 %). SEQ 0x77.

vectors.name: slot_light_opt_points
vectors.description: Flags 0x03. As slot_light_opt plus 3 points (M, mireds x 10): (65535, 3704) 2700 K at full, (16384, 4545) 2200 K at 25 %, (3277, 5556) 1800 K at 5 %; the 4th point unused (0, 0). SEQ 0x78.

vectors.name: slot_scene_effect
vectors.description: Effect 5 (candle) as light 0's power-on effect, on its SCENE values (slot_scene). Parameters as EFFECT without the start time: intensity 32768 (0.5), speed 100 %. Boards from before 0.2.3 ignore it. SEQ 0x79.

vectors.name: slot_config_soft_start
vectors.description: LIGHT 0xF (board). One pair: id 23 (soft start), value 0 (off; persisted). The other 8 pairs unused (0, 0). SEQ 0x45.

vectors.name: slot_config_retry_loss
vectors.description: LIGHT 0xF (board). Two pairs: id 24 (the trips' retry policy; persisted), value 0x0302 = 2 retries 3 s apart; id 8 (signal loss), value 3 = fade to the power-on scene. The other 7 pairs unused (0, 0). A board from before 0.2.5 skips id 24 and ignores the value 3 (out of its range: its own setting stays). SEQ 0x46.

vectors.name: slot_poll_status
vectors.description: LIGHT 0xF (board). Index 0, R = 2 response slots, page 0x00 STATUS, rate 0 (1 Mbaud), no arguments. Only in an RW frame. SEQ 0x60.

vectors.name: slot_poll_relay
vectors.description: Index 0xFF: the board turns around and relays the answers of the boards behind it, but doesn't answer (its page is ignored). The same R and rate as the frame's other POLLs. SEQ 0x61.

vectors.name: slot_poll_power_ack
vectors.description: Index 1, R = 2, page 0x08 POWER, rate 0. Arguments from slot byte 7: 0x01 ACK, then the counts the host last read (u16 each): 3 limit events, 1 overload trip, 0 short trips, 2 supply dips. SEQ 0x62.

vectors.name: slot_poll_lifetime
vectors.description: Index 0, R = 1, page 0x0C LIFETIME, rate 1 (500 kbaud), no arguments. A board from before 0.2.5 answers UNSUPPORTED (0xFF). SEQ 0x63.

vectors.name: slot_poll_diag_faults
vectors.description: Index 0, R = 1, page 0x0D DIAG, rate 1. Argument 0 (slot byte 7) = 1: the fault memory and the calibration trend (0: the running board; 2-255: UNSUPPORTED). SEQ 0x64.

vectors.name: slot_poll_life_sync
vectors.description: Index 0, R = 1, page 0x0E LIFE_SYNC, rate 1. Arguments from slot byte 7 (ULTRA_LS_*): UID16 0x1234; LIFETIME bytes 0-15 as the hub's ledger has them: powered 10020 x 0.1 h, lit 4010 x 0.1 h, 531 power-ups, overload trips 5, short trips 1, 22 supply dips; the lifetime energy 9050 Wh; RECORDS' low byte 7. A board from before 0.2.6 answers UNSUPPORTED (0xFF). SEQ 0x65.

vectors.name: slot_poll_identity_features
vectors.description: Index 0, R = 1, page 0x04 IDENTITY, rate 1. Argument 0 (slot byte 7) = 1: the firmware's 192 feature bits (0: the board, its UID, versions, hardware id and revision, capabilities; 2-255: UNSUPPORTED). SEQ 0x66.

vectors.name: slot_pixel_fx
vectors.description: Effect 7, START -1234 ms (relative to the header TIME), speed 100, intensity 150, palette 0xFE (c1 -> c2 -> c3), c1 = 255 128 0, c2 = 10 20 30, c3 = 40 50 60, brightness 128, transition 1500 ms, pixels 5 .. 94 of the strip, FLAGS 0x09 (reverse, auto-white accurate), custom 1 and 2 = 1, 2. Only the Ultra-Digital receiver (ULTRA_HWCAP_PIXEL_FX) takes it; every other board ignores the type. SEQ 0x09.

vectors.name: slot_pixel_fx_stream
vectors.description: Effect 0: the hub's pixels pass again (every other field but STORE is ignored). START 500 ms. SEQ 0x0A.

vectors.name: slot_pixel_fx_restart
vectors.description: Effect 20, START 0 (a new START: the time-driven effects begin again there), the effect's own palette, c1 white, brightness 255, FLAGS 0x60 = RESTART (0x40) | LOCK (0x20). RESTART is an action: the receiver starts the effect over (random effects re-seeded); without it the same slot with only a new START is a renewal that changes nothing. It is not stored and not repeated by the refresh. SEQ 0x0B.

vectors.name: slot_config_pixel
vectors.description: LIGHT 0xF (board). Nine pairs: id 129 chip = 3 (SK6812 RGBW), 130 wire order G R B W, 131 pixels = 300, 132 frames per second at most = 60, 133 LED current per channel = 200 x 0.1 mA, 134 current limit = 0 (the link's), 135 auto-white accurate, 136 / 137 no virtual strip. Ids 138 and 139 follow in a second CONFIG. A board without these ids skips them. SEQ 0x47.

vectors.name: slot_poll_pixel_fx_effects
vectors.description: Index 0, R = 1, page 0x81 PIXEL_FX, rate 1. Argument 0 (slot byte 7) = 1: the effects the firmware has, as a 192-bit map (0: the state; 2: the palettes; 3-255: UNSUPPORTED). SEQ 0x67.

vectors.name: slot_identify_power_off
vectors.description: Value 7, argument 0 (ultra_slot_power_off): 3 copies with the same SEQ (applied once) at 0, 50 and 100 ms, the line's power cut at 200 ms. A Diff-Power Ultra-Analog receiver (ULTRA_FEAT_STANDBY) fades to dark and takes the cut as planned (no supply dip); other boards and firmware from before 0.2.6 ignore it. SEQ 0x59.

vectors.name: frame_1board_set
vectors.description: Board 0: slot_set. Header TIME 0x00ABCDEF.

vectors.name: frame_3board_mixed
vectors.description: Board 0: slot_light_def. Board 1: slot_effect_breathe. Board 2: NOP (nothing to do). The first board sees all 104 bytes, the second 72, the third 40.

vectors.name: frame_config
vectors.description: Board 0: slot_config.

vectors.name: frame_effect
vectors.description: Board 0: slot_effect_pulse.

vectors.name: frame_idle_2boards
vectors.description: Keep-alive / refresh frame when there is nothing to send: NOP in every slot.

vectors.name: frame_preamble_dark_2boards
vectors.description: The start-up preamble for 2 boards is 10 of these frames (4 x N + 2), each with a fresh TIME. DARK slots are zero bits and never valid.

vectors.name: frame_rw_poll
vectors.description: Header FLAGS 0x01 (RW). Board 0: slot_poll_relay. Board 1: slot_poll_status (answer index 0). Board 2: slot_poll_power_ack (index 1). Every POLL has R = 2 and rate 0, so the window is W = 1000 + 2 x 460 = 1920 us (ultra_rw_window_us) after the frame's last falling edge; the host's next frame comes >= W + 200 us after it. Board 1 answers at 1000 us, board 2 at 1460 us; each burst is a 0xFF lead byte and the 32-byte answer.

vectors.name: frame_power_off
vectors.description: Every board's slot: slot_identify_power_off (SEQ 0x59). The hub sends this frame at 0, 50 and 100 ms (the same SEQ: each board applies it once; the time differs) and cuts the line's power at 200 ms.

vectors.name: answer_life_sync_applied
vectors.description: The answer to slot_poll_life_sync from a board that was behind in every field by less than its step (before: powered 10000 x 0.1 h, lit 4000 x 0.1 h, 501 power-ups, trips 3 / 1, 20 dips, 9000 Wh; RECORDS 7): DATA 0-15 the LIFETIME counters after the merge (the ledger's), 16-19 the lifetime energy 9050 Wh, 20 the result 0 APPLIED, 21 the counters raised 0x3F (powered, lit, power-ups, trips, dips, energy), 22-23 RECORDS 7. Index 0, RFLAGS 0, SEQ 0x65, UID16 0x1234.

vectors.name: answer_identity_board
vectors.description: An Ultra-Analog receiver: DATA 0-11 the MCU UID (00 11 22 .. BB), 12-15 the firmware version word 0x00060BFF (0.6.11, a release), 16 bootloader 2, 17 hardware id 2, 18 revision 0, 19 reserved 0, 20-23 the capabilities 0x0000000F (answers, relays, bus voltage, input current). The answer to a POLL of part 0 (argument 0 = 0) with SEQ 0x67: index 0, RFLAGS 0, UID16 the CRC-16 of the UID.

vectors.name: answer_identity_features
vectors.description: The same board, to slot_poll_identity_features: DATA 0-23 six u32 words, big-endian; word 0 = 0x007FFFFF (feature bits 0-22: SCENE .. LIFE_SYNC), words 1-5 = 0. Index 0, RFLAGS 0, SEQ 0x66.
